This '''[[Starship/Legends|starship]]''' was owned by [[Dezono Qua]] and operated by his [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]],
known as [[H2]]. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] killed Qua and took the ship,
as well as H2, for himself. He used it to travel to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] and, later, [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]].

On the way to [[Vondarc/Legends|Vondarc]], it was damaged in a dogfight with two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 ''Nimbus''-class V-wing starfighters]] over the planet [[Prine]] and crashed.<ref name="Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness 1">[[Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness 1|''Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness'' 1]]</ref>
